Ice Box CafeteriaDeadpool 2Family-sized. Like the team.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersChimichanga bitesFried tortilla rolls of shredded chipotle beef and cheddarHow to make it800g beef chuck2 chipotle chillies in adobo, chopped500ml water200g cheddar, grated12 small flour tortillas1 L vegetable oil for frying150ml sour cream3 tomatoes, dicedPut the beef in a pot with the chipotle and water.Braise gently until it shreds easily, then shred.Roll small amounts of beef and cheddar in the tortillas, folding in the sides.Fry seam side down in the vegetable oil until crisp all over.Serve with sour cream and tomato salsa.Dopinder's taxi samosasCrisp fried triangles filled with spiced potato and peasHow to make it600g potatoes150g frozen peas1 tbsp garam masala12 spring rolls of pastry sheets1 L vegetable oil for frying2 tbsp tamarind paste1 tsp sugar3 tbsp waterBoil and crush the potatoes with the peas and garam masala, then cool.Cut the pastry into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles.Fry in the vegetable oil until golden and crisp.Mix the tamarind with sugar and water to serve alongside.MainsWade and Vanessa's steak fritesSeared sirloin in a red wine pan sauce, oven chipsHow to make it1kg potatoes3 tbsp oil4 sirloin steaks50g butter150ml red wine250ml beef stockCut the potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast until crisp.Sear the steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest.Add the red wine and stock to the pan and reduce until glossy.Slice the steak and serve by candlelight.Firefist's flame-grilled peri peri chickenRussell, the kid in the Ice Box with fire for fistsHow to make it8 chicken thigh fillets3 red chillies4 garlic cloves2 lemons1 tsp smoked paprika1 tbsp red wine vinegar60ml olive oil300g basmati rice1 tsp ground turmeric300g red cabbage2 carrots3 tbsp mayonnaiseBlitz the chillies, garlic, juice of 1 lemon, paprika, vinegar, 3 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of salt. Toss with the chicken and leave for 20 minutes.Simmer the rice with the turmeric and 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5.Cook the chicken in a hot grill pan with the rest of the oil for 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked through.Shred the cabbage and grate the carrots, then toss with the mayonnaise and a squeeze of the other lemon.Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the slaw.SweetsRed suit raspberry cheesecakeBaked cheesecake on a biscuit base with raspberryHow to make it250g sweet biscuits100g butter, melted500g cream cheese150g caster sugar3 eggs250g raspberries2 tbsp caster sugar for the sauceCrush the biscuits with the butter and press into a lined tin.Beat the cream cheese and sugar, then beat in the eggs and pour over the base.Bake at 160°C, then turn off the oven and cool inside.Chill overnight.Simmer the raspberries with sugar, push through a sieve and spoon over the top.DrinksCable's cold brew espresso martiniVodka, coffee liqueur and cold brew shaken until frothyHow to make it240ml cold brew coffee160ml vodka80ml coffee liqueur40ml sugar syrup12 coffee beans1 bag iceChill 4 martini glasses in the freezer.For each drink, measure 60ml cold brew coffee, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup into a shaker.Shake each drink very hard with plenty of ice for 15 seconds so it foams, then strain into the glass.Float three coffee beans on top of each. Make it in batches of one or two.
